passages.title: Fractured Stories: Changing Perspectives
passages.text: In the first version of the tale, villagers heard heavy footsteps and believed a giant had come to destroy their bridge. They locked their doors. In the giant’s version, he had travelled for two days because a flood had left his home without clean water. He approached the bridge to ask for help, but no one answered. A young baker eventually listened and brought him a bucket. Both versions describe the same footsteps, yet they lead readers to judge the giant differently.
